source.title: Coordination of Projects with Provisional/Conditional GIAs

stakeholders.impact: MISO (Transmission Provider): study cycles, notices, restudies, GIA filing.
Neighboring RTO (PJM/SPP/MH): affected-system studies and limits.
Affected System / neighboring TO: coordination and restudy of impacts.
Transmission Owner: scoping, facilities, local criteria, construction.

text:
6.4.4 Coordination of Projects with Provisional/Conditional GIAs

If a generation interconnection project is conditional upon Network Upgrades on the Affected
System and comes in service prior to those Network Upgrades being completed, that project’s
output will be subject to limitations in accordance with that respective RTO’s tariff.
